name: #DrinkPrime

When you have a Ring Face card, you count as having +5F for playing maneuvers. When this card is revealed, Recover those cards (or put in your Backlash, if applicable). When an 'ECW' Title Belt is in your Ring, during your first Draw Segment of the game, Promo: 8 and Recover 8- Ringside cards. Your Ability counts as blank for your effects, and when playing a Foreign Object, you may blank it this turn.

name: Main Event Jey Uso
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. At the end of the Pre-match, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver, 1 non-Unique reversal, and 1 Superstar-specific non-reversal action; when you have lower Superstar Value, randomly Recover 1 of those cards. After all Pre-match are resolved, you may put Pay-Per-View Main Event from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring.

name: Mandy Rose
Text: When your maneuver is successful, RFG 1 Opponent's Ringside card; when it is not, they RFG 2 of their Ringside cards. You can pack Tough Enough and Total Divas; you cannot pack Lethal nWo Poison.

name: Maverick Frog Splash
Text: When you have a Ring 'Table' card, this card is +5D, Multi: 3, and ignore 'completely' on reversals to it. Your opponent discards 2. In Hand: during your turn you may reveal it, Bury it, and draw 2-.

name: Mr. Ass's Tilt-a-Whirl Slam
Text: As a maneuver, Arsenal/Ringside Search 1 TMF. As a reversal, reverse a maneuver played from Ringside (even when played 'as if from Hand').

name: Mr. Technicolor
Text: As an action, Recover this card and put 1 Opponent's Ring cards into their Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver when you have a Ring maneuver of that type.

name: My World, My Earth, My Turf, My Land
Text: As an action, Eliminate 4- Ring cards and Bury that many Ringside cards. As a reversal, reverse a card that would move a card from your Ring or Ringside. When successful, Recover 4- Hand cards and draw that many. ACE: When your opponent would move a card from your Ring or Ringside, you may overturn 1 card instead.

name: Name Drop Elbow
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a successful Action. Arsenal Search YEAH!

name: No YEET
Text: You may put the reversed card in your opponent's Ring. ACE: You may Bury this card from your Ring and then put 1 Opponent's Ringside card into their Ring.

name: Oh My Brother...
Text: -5F when you have a 'Brother' Ring card. As an action, when you have lower Fortitude or fewer Hand cards, can only be reversed from Backlash. When successful, Bury 3- Ringside cards and 1- RFG card, and Arsenal Search Testify!

name: Old School Clothesline
Text: Counts as a Strike for your effects. Can only be played after a successful 5D+ maneuver.

name: One Lucky Punch
Text: When you have no Ring maneuvers, F: 0; if not, +1 Stun and when played choose one: -#F or +#D (# = opponent's Fortitude). Cannot be reversed by non-unique cards.

name: Paying the (Right) Price
Text: When you have a 'Price' Ring card, cannot be reversed from Hand. When successful and you have lower Fortitude, cannot be reversed from Arsenal and the damage cannot be modified. In Ring: Your actions counts as Set-ups for The Price We Pay.

name: Phenom's Leg Drop
Text: Cannot be packed by Brothers of Destruction. Cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. As a maneuver, can only be played after a maneuver or as a Counter. As an action, Bury this card and 1- Ringside card, and draw 1-.

name: Phenomenal Arrival
Text: You may put cards on The Urn when there are cards on it. When you discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us, you may put those cards on The Urn. When your Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, you may Bury 1 card on The Urn; if so, Recover your unsuccessful card and draw 1. You count as Bobby Fish for Throat-Cutting Taunt.

name: Pimpin' Back Kick
Text: As a maneuver, -7F; when played as a Counter, can only be reversed by Unique cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Grapple. When successful, Bury 3- RFG cards and your opponent Buries 1 random Hand card.

name: Reaper of Lost Souls
Text: Choose one: Recover #- Ringside cards and draw 2-; or your opponent randomly Buries # Hand cards and draws that many -2 (# = your Superstar Value). In Backlash/Ringside/RFG: When your maneuver is unsuccessful and you have 5+ lower Fortitude, you may put this card into your Ring; your opponent Recovers their hand and draws that many -2.

name: Return to the Extreme
Text: Multi: 3. Ringside Search 2- cards. In Ring: your 'Buh-Buh' cards do not count as Hybrid for reversals. ACE: When you are Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, you may put this card from your Ring into your Ringside and then reverse any Action.

name: Roadhouse
Text: Recover 2- Ringside cards and draw 2-. In Ring: once per turn when you successfully play 2+ Strikes, you may Bury 2- Ringside cards.

name: Rosey: Bischoff's Enforcer
Text: In Ring: When your Raw maneuver is unsuccessful, your opponent overturns 3. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may put 1 Ring non-Unique Raw card into your Ringside and then your Fortitude is +3F this turn.

name: Running Through the Competition
Text: Put 1- non-Hybrid action that does not have 'win the game' in the text from your Ringside into your Ring, and Arsenal Search 1 card (do not reveal).

name: Scary Sherri
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, they Recover any 'Manager,' 'Interfere', and Run-in Hand cards. Draw that many cards (min. 2). As a reversal, completely reverse any Face, Heel, Fan Favorite, or Cheater card; Bury 1 RFG card.

name: Shoot Counter - Errata
Text: Requirement: Ring 'Shoot' card. When you have a Ring 'Shoot' maneuver, +3D. Reverse any card that moves any number of Ringside cards, any card that allows your opponent to draw, or any non-Unique Hybrid.

name: Shoot Lock-Up - Errata
Text: When played, you may make this card Multi. Cannot be reversed by 'Counter' reversals. In Ring: once per turn when you would play a 'Shoot' maneuver, you may count as having a successfully played a 4D+ 'Shoot' maneuver first for your printed 'Shoot' card effects.

name: Sister Sherri
Text: Recover 4- Ringside cards and put 2- Ringside maneuvers in your Hand. ACE: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, you may put this card into your Ringside and then your next Strike played this turn can only be reversed from Arsenal. When you are Sherri Martel, this effect can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. In Ringside: When you are Sherri Martel, during your turn you may RFG 5 Ringside cards and put this into your Backlash.

name: Slap a Hold on 'em!
Text: -#F (# = opponent's Fortitude). They Bury 1 Hand card. In Ring: Your Submissions are +1D. In Ringside: When you would use your Ability, you may put this card into your Backlash instead.

name: Snake Eyes and Big Boot
Text: When played, you may overturn 2; if so, can only be reversed by 2 Unique cards. Bury 1- RFG card and draw 1-; when The Dead Man's Motorcycle is in your Ring, double those numbers.

name: So... What Do You Want To Talk About?
Text: When your opponent's Action becomes successful, you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring, and resolve a copy of their card's effects after they do. ACE: During your turn, you may Arsenal Search 1 Superstar-specific card, and then Eliminate this card and they draw 1-.

name: Spike's Diving Footstomp
Text: Can only be played after a successful card or as a Counter. When played after From the Top Rope, can only be reversed from Hand.

name: Steamboat's Celebrated Career
Text: Packed: You are a WCW Superstar, and you can pack 8- 'From' or 'Japanese' Set-ups Hidden in your Backstage; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1- in your Hand and Recover the rest. You can play Where The Big Boys Play during the Events phase. Your 'From' and 'Japanese' cards count as Fan Favorite for A Legendary Comeback, and ignore that card's 'When this card...' text.

name: Stranger Rings
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Rhea Ripley or The Champ. At the end of each of your turns, Flip this card face-down. When this card is Flipped face-up, Flip 1 other card in any Ring and Recover this card.

name: Student Section Support
Text: Cannot be reversed from Hand or Ring. Put 1- Superstar-specific Backlash card from RFG or Ringside into your Backlash, and Bury 2- RFG cards. When your Superstar-specific maneuver is successful, you may Promo: 2.

name: Student: Bodhi Hayward
Text: When you play a Strike or Grapple as a Counter, it is +2D; you may overturn 1 and blank that card. When your 'Back', 'Block', 'Drop', 'Run', or 'Slam' maneuver is successful, draw 1-. When your Strike or Grapple is unsuccessful, your opponent overturns # (# = total Damage of their played reversals to your card, max. 3).

name: Student: Duke Hudson
Text: When you play a Strike or Grapple that does not have 'reversed' in the text, you may discard 2 or 3 and your maneuver is now Multi: # (# = number of cards discarded).

name: Student: Thea Hail
Text: During your Draw Segment, you may draw 2 more cards and overturn 1. Before you play a maneuver, you may overturn 1 and play it as if you have your opponent's Fortitude. Your A Teachable Moment is -6F and can also reverse Unique cards.

name: Tables Match
Text: When you have an ECW Backstage Card, this card is an Event; ACE: when your opponent's maneuver is unsuccessful, you may Eliminate 1 'Table!' card and then they overturn 3. When any player reverses a 5D+ maneuver, they may skip their next Draw Segment or Bury 2 Hand cards before it, and play a 'Table!' action from Hand or Ringside; ignore 'Can only be played...', and when played from Hand, it is F: 0, ignore 'Can only be played...', and it can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. When your 'Table' ACE is successful, you may allow them to ignore reversal restrictions from Arsenal; if you do, RFG the damage applied from the affected maneuver.

name: Take It to the Boneyard
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, your turn does not end. Discard this card, RFG 1- Ringside card, and Ringside Search 1- card. In Ringside: Counts as Wrestlemania for your effects; when your maneuver is successful, Bury this card.

name: Teaching the Basics
Text: When packed, cards listed on Back to Basics count as Superstar-specific for Textbook Offense. Arsenal Search 10- cards with titles listed on Back to Basics and/or printed 'Textbook' cards, and put them under this card. During your turn you may play them as if from Hand, they are Volley: #, and when your first card each turn played from under this is unsuccessful, your turn does not end (# = the card's printed Damage +3). You count as having Back to Basics in your Ring for your non-'Psychology' card effects.

name: Thank You Trish!
Text: Recover 3- RFG cards and draw 2-. Your opponent chooses one: you Recover # Ringside cards or they overturn # (# = your Superstar-specific Ring cards); when you are Canada's Greatest Export, choose both options.

name: The 40-Year-Old Banger
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Sheamus, Pete Dunne, Ridge Holland, Drew McIntyre, The Scottish Warrior, or The Brawling Brutes. When your opponent plays a reversal to reverse your next maneuver this turn, they discard 4.

name: The Bad Ass Billy Gunn
Text: Cannot be packed by New Age Outlaws. Arsenal Search any Billy Gunn-specific non-Hybrid actions and put them in your Backlash; they are Mid-match until played or discarded. When you have lower Fortitude, your non-Superstar-specific maneuvers cannot be reversed by D: 1+ reversals; when you do not and use your Ability, the maneuver revealed cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: The Beast Behind the Beauty
Logos: Toxic Attraction, Mandy Rose, Jacy Jayne, Gigi Dolin
Text: When you are Toxic Attraction, Multi: 3 and ignore 'completely' in reversals to this card. Ringside Search 3- maneuvers. In Ring: your maneuvers are +3D and +1 Stun.

name: The Boss of the Dudley Family
Text: Packed: you can pack High-Flying Style, Greetings from Dudleyville, USA, and Dudley Tough. Arsenal Search Don't Cross the Boss. Once during each of your turns when you have lower Fortitude, you may Bury 1 Hand card and RFG 1 Ring card, and choose 1 D: #- Opponent's Ring card; they choose one: put the chosen card in their Ringside or Bury 2 Hand cards (# = Damage of your Ring card moved).

name: The Clock is Tickin' and We're In The Clear
Text: Bury 3- Hand cards and draw that many +3; your opponent Buries 3 Hand cards and overturns 3. In Ring: you may Bury cards discarded for your Ability. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card from your Ring into your Ringside and then your next maneuver played this turn is Multi: 3.

name: The Final Boss
Text: Packed: you can pack A Family Legacy, and cards as if you are a Chairman. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your Team Bring It! ACE cannot be reversed, and do not move the revealed actions from Hand.

name: The Fratliner
Text: When you are a Tag Team, this card is Multi and +10D, and cannot be reversed from Hand or Backlash by cards with 'completely' in the text. In Ring: When you are not a Tag Team, and your opponent's effect causes you to discard, they overturn 1; when they have greater Fortitude, they also Bury 1 Hand card.

name: The Golden Goddess
Text: When your foil or Superstar-specific card is successful, you may draw 1 and Bury 1 Hand card. Replace a Superstar listed on NXT Women's Championship Title Belt with 'Mandy Rose', and your Superstar-specific cards count as 'Diva' cards for Total Divas.

name: The Great One's Corporate Endeavor
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. When your Superstar-specific maneuver or card with 'The Rock' or 'Chairman' in the text is unsuccessful, your opponent reveals their hand, choose 1 action, and they Bury it.

name: The Maverick
Text: When played as a Counter, your non-Hybrid maneuver is -#F and cannot be reversed from Backlash by non-Superstar-specific reversals; when it is a High Risk, it counts as played after a successful D: # maneuver or a card for your effects (# = choose one: the Damage of the reversed card, or the total printed Damage of your reversals played to it).

name: The Megastar
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to your Listen Loud and Clear. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 of your Ring Actions and Promo: 2; when you RFG Grab The Mic!, Promo: 3 instead. Your maneuvers are +1D for each of your Ring Actions. When their Action is successful, you may Promo: 2.

name: The Persian Club Challenge
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Packed: your Ring Psychology: Neck and Ring Psychology: Back are Heat (ignore 'If you have 6...' in the text), and your printed Heat maneuvers and 'Break' and 'Camel' maneuvers counts as having 'Neck' and 'Back' in the title for their effects. When your opponent reverses your Drawing Extra Heat, your turn does not end, but you cannot play that card for the rest of the turn.

name: The Professor of Chase University
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played during any Phase. When your card with 'Chase U' in the text is successful, draw 1-. Your 'Textbook' maneuvers and cards listed on Back to Basics and WWE Homecoming are Chain; when they are unsuccessful, and they are RMS or you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent Buries 2 Hand cards.

name: The Professor's Side Effect
Text: When played after a maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash. When played after a card with 'Chase U' in the text, cannot be reversed from Hand. Ringside Search 1- card and put 1- Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: The Spirit of Ultimate Warrior Will Run Forever
Text: When your Multi maneuver is completely reversed from Arsenal, Bury 1- random Ringside card and your opponent overturns 2. When Back to Basics is not in your Ring, your Ability is blank, and once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 and then Ring Search 1 non-reversal maneuver without a printed reversal restriction. During your turn you may hide this card and put any number of Ringside maneuvers under Back to Basics.

name: The Streak
Text: When Wrestlemania is in your Ring, your opponent must Bury 2 Hand cards to play reversals to your first Superstar-specific card played each turn. Ignore 'non-Unique' on your Superstar-specific reversals. When you have #- Hand cards, draw 1 more card for your Draw Segment; when you play a Superstar-specific TMF, Recover #- Ringside cards (# = your Superstar Value).

name: The Ultimate Influencer
Text: When your maneuver is successful, during their next turn their maneuvers also count as those types for your effects. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may RFG 2 Ringside cards and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 non-hybrid non-reversal with Fortitude equal or lower than their Fortitude; if the first card played on their next turn is not the chosen card, they discard 2.

name: Throw In The Towel' Match
Text: Cannot be blocked. Arsenal Search Backed by Arnold Skaaland and put it into your Ring. In Ring: Your Maintain Hold cannot be reversed, and your opponent's cards cannot RFG your Ringside 'Textbook' cards. Any player wins the game via Pinfall Victory when their Maintained maneuver applies 4D+ for two consecutive turns.

name: Thrown into the Ring Steps
Text: As a maneuver, when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, -10F and can be played from Ringside. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude: your opponent cannot play D: 1+ reversals to this card. As a reversal, -4D; reverse any non-Unique non-Superstar-specific action.

name: Tie Dye Attire
Logos: Billy Graham, Dude Love, Spike Dudley
Text: As an action, Ringside Search 1 Hybrid card and Recover 3- Ringside Hybrid cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Hybrid card. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 and then Recover #- Ringside cards (# = card types of the discarded card).

name: TitanEST
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Bianca Belair, Montez Ford, or Street Profits. Choose 1 Opponent's Ring card, they Elminate it and overturn equal to that card's Damage (max. 8).

name: To The Man-Cave!
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are Becky Lynch, The Man, Seth Rollins, or The Visionary. Promo: 6 and Bury 6- Ringside cards. When your next card played this turn is a 'Precision' card, it cannot be reversed.

name: Top Deck
Text: Cannot be reversed when you are The Miz or Maryse. Recover this and Stack 1 Ringside card.

name: Tougher than Pitbulls
Text: Your opponent's maneuvers are -1D. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, put your top Arsenal card under this card. When you use your Ability, you may put the card under this card instead. You may RFG 1 card under this card to reduce the damage of their successful maneuver by 3D. Once during each of your turns you may Bury 1 card under this card and choose one: your next maneuver played this turn is -7F, or when you have greater Fortitude, they overturn 2.

name: Toxic
Text: When this reverses a non-manuever, your opponent overturns 3. When this reverses a maneuver, Recover 3- Ringside cards. Choose one: draw 3- or Arsenal Search 1 card.

name: Toxic Attraction
Text: Before your Draw Segment, your opponent may randomly RFG 2 of their Ringside cards; if not, they overturn 2. You are a Tag Team. You cannot pack Lethal nWo Poison.

name: Toxic Shock
Text: When played as a Counter, your opponent must RFG their top 3 Arsenal cards to play reversals to this card. Recover 3- Ringside cards and 3- RFG cards.

name: Toxic Teamwork
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Promo: 3, Bury 3- Ringside cards, and put 1- Ringside card under We Are THE Attraction. When overturned during your opponent's turn, they RFG their top Arsenal card.

name: Trish Hook
Text: When playing this card, you can play a printed D: 5- Submission from Hand; unless both are reversed, both are successful. Draw 1-. In Ring: when your Action or Superstar-specific maneuver is unsuccessful, put 1- Unique Trish Stratus-specific action from your Hand or Ringside into your Ring.

name: Trish's Chick Kick
Text: As a maneuver, -15F. In Hand: during your turn you may discard this card and your next card played this turn is -5F. In Ring: your Stratusfaction Bulldog is +10D.

name: Trish's Sharpshooter
Text: Put 1 Opponent's Ring card into their Ringside, Bury 2- Ringside cards, and choose one: Arsenal Search Maintain Hold or Draw 1-. In Ringside: when your Superstar-specific action is successful, you may Bury this card.

name: Turning a Negative into a Positive
Text: Replace '#-' with '#+', and replace '-#' with '+#' in the text of all other cards until the start of your next turn. In Ring: when you have lower Fortitude, draw 1- more card during your Draw Segment.

name: Undertaker's Death Valley Dive
Text: Can only be played after a successful 4D+ maneuver. Your opponent randomly Buries 1 Hand card. When Casket Match is not in your Ringside: can be played as a Counter (maneuver), and cannot be reversed from Backlash; when their maneuver is successful, you may put this card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: Uso Snap Superkick
Logos: Jimmy Uso, Jey Uso, The Usos
Text: As a maneuver, -10F and +5D; when you are not the Usos, this counts as Superkick for your effects. As a reversal, when you are not the Usos, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Action. In Hand: when your opponent's D: 10+ Strike is successful, you may put this card into your Ring instead of applying damage.

name: Usos: Superkick Specialists
Logos: Jey Uso, Jimmy Uso, The Usos
Text: Revealed: Put this card in your Ring. Once during each of your turns, you may play a Hand card face-down as an F: 0 D: 5 S: 1 Strike titled 'Superkick'; when it was a printed reversal, discard 1. After damage is applied for your Superkick, you may put it under this card (when that card is face-down, you must put it under this card). Your Fortitude is +5 for each card under this card.

name: Vengeance Unearthed
Text: Can be played from RFG. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 2-, they RFG them. Opponent's Arsenal Search 3- cards, RFG them, and RFG 2- of their Ring cards. In Ring: Your opponent draws 2 fewer cards for your effects, and their maneuvers are -2D and -1 Stun.

name: WCW's Legendary Rivalry
Text: Packed: you can pack 16- 'Chop' cards Hidden in your Backstage, but you cannot pack Back to Basics. During your turn you may play 'Chop' cards from Backstage as if from Hand, ignore 'Can only be played...', and they are Chain when played. When you have 5- lower Fortitude and your 'Chop' is unsuccessful, Arsenal/Ringside Search 16-Time Heavyweight Champion and put it in your Ring.

name: We Are Just Getting Started
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3, and your opponent's Hand Size is -1. ACE: During your turn you may put this card under We Are THE Attraction and then when your next card played this turn is an F: 0 maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: We Are THE Attraction
Logos: Toxic Attraction, Mandy Rose, Jacy Jayne, Gigi Dolin
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your opponent's non-F: 0 reversals are +3F for each card under this card. When they RFG Ringside cards for your Ability, put 1- Hand card under this card. When their maneuver is successful, choose one: put 1 card under this card into your hand, or put 1- Ringside card under this card.

name: We're Hardcore 24/7
Text: *Can only be revealed when a Stipulation with 'Foreign Object' in the text is played. Cannot be packed by an ECW Superstar. Packed: your Everything and the Kitchen Sink is Unique; you cannot pack First Blood Match, ECW One Night Stand, an ECW Backstage Card, or an ECW Allegiance. When you have 1+ lower Fortitude, your Chicago Street Fight ACE cannot be reversed, and your opponent cannot play D: 2+ reversals to your Foreign Object maneuvers.

name: Weight Belt Whip
Logos: The Great One, Hulk Hogan, The Tribal Chief
Text: When you are Hulk Hogan, this card is nWo. Cannot be reversed by Hybrids. In Ring: your opponent discards 1 when they play an action. ACE: During your turn you may RFG 1 of your other Ring cards, and then put this card into your Hand.

name: Which One Are You?
Text: Your Superkick and Samoan Drop cards are Multi; when once per turn when they are unsuccessful, you may discard 1, overturn 1, continue the turn, and Arsenal Search 1 maneuver with the same title, but you can only play cards with that title for the rest of the turn. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your Superkick is a High Risk instead.

name: Whose Game Is It?
Text: Can be played from Ringside. When you have lower Fortitude, -#F and cannot be reversed from Hand or Backlash. Put 3- RFG cards into your Ringside, put 3- Ringside Backlash cards into your Backlash, and draw 3- cards. When your next card played is Superstar-specific, it cannot be reversed from Hand or Backlash.

name: Win or Lose, You're Going Thru a Table!
Text: Your 'Table' cards are Multi, cannot be reversed by Hybrids, and ignore 'completely' on reversals to them. After damage is applied from your maneuver affected by 'Table' cards, you may immediately play Catatonic Stare regardless of reversals, and your opponent cannot respond to it; when they are a female Superstar, they overturn 3.

name: With Everybody Sayin'... L! A! Knight!
Text: Cannot be blanked. As an Event, -10F; at the end of the Pre-match phase you may randomly discard 1, Arsenal Search 1 non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver, and put this card into your Backlash. As an action, Arsenal Search YEAH! and choose 1: draw 3, Promo: 3, or your next card played cannot be reversed from Hand. In Ringside/RFG: during your turn you may overturn 3 and put this card into your Backlash.

name: WrestleMania Goes Hollywood!
Text: -5F when Wrestlemania is in your Ring. Choose one: your opponent cannot play Hybrid reversals to your next Movie card this turn without reversal restriction from your effects; put 1- non-unique card with an ACE from their Ring into their Ringside; or until the start of your next turn, they cannot modify your reversal cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you can discard 1 Movie card, and then put this card from your Ring or Ringside into your Backlash and end the turn.

name: YEAH!
Text: As an action, -1D; Promo: 2. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any card. When successful and damage is applied, Recover this card.

name: YEET
Text: RFG the reversed card. ACE: During your may RFG this card from your Ring and then RFG 1 Opponent's Ringside card.

name: YEET! Punches
Text: When played, you may RFG 3- Ringside cards; this card is +# Stun, and choose one: your opponent must RFG # Hand cards to play Hand reversals to this card, OR RFG cards overturned for this card's damage. (# = your cards RFG for this effect).

name: You Are a Plebeian and an Ignoramus!
Text: Cannot be reversed when Mister Backlund is revealed. Choose any number of Ringside maneuvers. Your opponent may RFG that many top Arsenal cards; if not, Recover the chosen cards.

name: You Can't Chain Up These Dogs
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your non-Multi non-Unique Submissions are Chain. In Backlash/Ringside/RFG: when your Superstar-specific card is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ring and Bury 1 Hand card. ACE: During your turn you may RFG 3 Ringside cards and then Bury 2- Ringside cards; when this effect is reversed, draw 2-.

name: You Can't Look Away
Text: When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from Hand. RFG any number of Hand cards and Ringside Search that many. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver. In Ring: overturn half as many for The NXT Breakout Star.

name: You Dumbass!
Text: Reverse any non-TMF card and RFG it. Recover 2- Ringside cards and your opponent Buries 2 Hand cards. In Ring: you may Bury 1 Hand card to Activate Chase University instead of overturning.

name: Your Ass is Grass...
Text: Reverse any D: 10+ non-Unique maneuver, or when you have no nWo Ring cards, any 10D+ maneuver. Promo: 6, Bury 9- Ringside cards, and Arsenal Search ...and I'm Gonna Smoke It!
